name: Bahamas

flag.description: Three equal horizontal bands of aquamarine, gold and aquamarine, with a black equilateral triangle at the hoist pointing into the stripes.
flag.symbolism: Aquamarine represents the surrounding sea, gold the sun and sandy beaches, and the black triangle the vigour and determination of the people.

hook: The Bahamas: a black arrowhead pointing into horizontal bands of aquamarine sea and golden sand; Jamaica splits black and green with a gold X instead.
trivia: The Bahamas is made up of roughly 700 islands and cays spread over a large area of the Atlantic.
Christopher Columbus's first landfall in the Americas in 1492 was on an island in the Bahamas.
